title: Inline nested interface types stretched the entire table
symptom: Example.asserts and Example.source forced large padding on otherwise short interface members.

rootCause.summary: The table shared an end column with long inline object types. A mechanically aligned table can still have poor structural readability.

requestedOutcome: Keep ordinary members compact and place exceptional nested type members below them in independent tables without changing field contracts.
decisions: Move only the explicitly requested type-only members; preserve names, types and optional/readonly modifiers.
Expand nested members rather than adding aliases solely to shorten a row.
Preserve runtime evaluation order elsewhere; the deterministic aligner does not relocate members.

actions.description: Move asserts and source below the ordinary Example fields and expand their member tables.
Measure display width and compare emitted JavaScript.
Complete independent review of the final combined changes.
